entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-04-08
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • ExecuteUpdateAsync throws SQLite Error 1: 'no such column: ...' when working with navigation properties in EFCore Sqlite #38010
    11.0.0
  • ExecuteUpdate generates invalid SQL for SQLite with TPT #31402
    11.0.0

Updated

  • Cosmos: Transactional batches can't be retried #38044
    11.0.0
  • SQL Server: consider lax vs. strict in queries (JSON_VALUE/OPENJSON) #36802
    Backlog
  • Support mapping multiple non-collection types to the same JSON column (JSON-splitting) #38061
    Backlog
  • Adding a stored procedure using raw SQL and then generating an idempotent migration script results in flawed SQL script #34555
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Warn on old migration snapshot major version during Migrate() #38065
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0' => 'release/10.0' #38064

Merged

    community-contribution, preview-4, 11.0.0
  • Fix SQLite ExecuteUpdate with navigation properties #38056
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0' => 'release/9.0' #37908
